items.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: "old Mac up there" he says, "I don’t know how many tunes or songs he knows, but" he says, "I hear him plunking around on the piano every once in a while."

ctx.x: I think you hit most of them. What was the first time you got out to play with a band?

Well some guy was looking for a piano player, someone to play a party for him. He was having a party one night, and he couldn’t find nobody.
